question: What coating thicknesses were reported for NCM@PANI and for NCM@PANI-PEG?
rendered: According to "Valuation of Surface Coatings in High-Energy Density Lithium-ion Battery Cathode Materials" (page 10), the thickness of the amorphous coatings was reported to be 25-30 nm, and the thickness of NCM@PANI-PEG was reported to be 30-35 nm.
